ambiguities: Matrana is written in Cardo; Matrona is the head at page107. The primary body does not explicitly equate these spellings. The editor points to Matrona, but the recommended literal model does not require or use that normalization.
Cardo benedictus is one full name and never an additional Cardo occurrence.

Senecio mentions carduncellus [terestris]. This counts the exact Carduncellus word under the declared lexical-incidence rule while retaining the modifier; it does not assert that all qualified botanical entities are identical.
Senecium, senechion, seneschon, Sene[s]cion and Senicion are not automatically counted as the exact six-universe name Senecio.
Mention edges deliberately pool explicit name occurrences across relation types; they are not labelled Respice or synonym equivalence.

B.body: carduncellus, [cressiones], senecio idem, senechion, ance. gowndeswilie. [Respice in labrum ueneris et in senecio.]

C.body: respice in labrum ueneris et in matrana.

L.body: cardo idem, folia habet lata et maculas albas in foliis, ualet contra opilacionem splenis et epatis, semine utimur, anglice sough thistil. [Respice in camelionta.]

M.body: cardo idem, gall. chardon, angl. thistel.

S.body: uel senecium, cardo benedictus, carduncellus [terestris], benedicta idem, tota herba utimur. gall. seneschon. ae. grounde-swile.
